audience: law firms and other professional-service firms that track time and billing in Bill4Time

useCases.title: Total the billable hours by person for a period
useCases.text: The AI lists time entries filtered by user and entry date range, with billable time and amount, and adds them up per timekeeper.

useCases.title: Find unpaid invoices and the clients behind them
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices by status and paid status, with client, totals and invoice date, and shows which clients still owe.

useCases.title: Review time entries for a client or matter
useCases.text: The AI lists the time entries of a client or project with date, user, activity, rate, billing status and description.

useCases.title: Review expenses by client and billing status
useCases.text: The AI lists expenses filtered by client, project, date range or billing status, with cost, sell price and type, and sums them up.

useCases.title: Check the payments you received
useCases.text: The AI lists payments with client, project, amount, date and method, filtered by client, project or payment date range.

useCases.title: Look up clients, matters and contacts
useCases.text: The AI lists clients, projects (matters) and contacts, filtered by status or creation date, with their basic details.
